definitions: A widespread computer virus that first appeared in May 2000, disguised as an email with the subject line "I LOVE YOU" and an attachment.
A type of malware that spreads rapidly through email, often by tricking users into opening an attachment that appears to be a love letter or similar enticing message.
examples: The LoveLetter attack caused billions of dollars in damages.
Many systems were vulnerable to the LoveLetter attack.
The LoveLetter attack exploited social engineering tactics.
